unit: tokens retained in model history per tool result (Codex tool_output_token_limit)
basis: Codex's own default keeps 10000 tokens of each result. These rows are reviewed values for named models; every other model gets the formula in request.mjs (deep = context window / 4 to the nearest power of two, balanced = deep / 2, compact = deep / 4, default deep). Proposed engineering values, not vendor settings or measured optima; context is the window Codex's model catalog advertised on the review date.
